description.zh: 关联资源标签规则列表。
description.en: A list of associated resource tag rules.

description.zh:
关联资源标签规则的设置名称。

具体取值，请参见[支持关联资源标签设置功能的资源](~~2586330~~)中的**规则设置名称**列。
description.en:
The setting name of the associated resource tag rule.

For valid values, see the **Setting name** column in [Resources that support associated resource tagging](~~2586330~~).

description.zh:
是否开启关联资源标签规则。取值：

- Enable（默认）：开启。
- Disable：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the associated resource tag rule. Valid values:

- Enable (default): The rule is enabled.

- Disable: The rule is disabled.

description.zh: 关联资源标签规则作用的标签键列表。
description.en: The tag keys to which the rule applies.

title.zh: 创建关联资源标签规则

example.legacyCli: aliyun tag CreateAssociatedResourceRules --region cn-hangzhou --CreateRulesList.1.ExistingStatus 'example-string' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CreateRulesList.1.SettingName 'rule:AttachEni-DetachEni-TagInstance:Ecs-Instance:Ecs-Eni' --CreateRulesList.1.Status Enable --CreateRulesList.1.TagKeys.1 k1
